# `/access-model-metadata` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /access-model-metadata/v1/attributes

`listAccessModelMetadataAttributeV1` — List access model metadata attributes

Get a list of Access Model Metadata Attributes. Supports pagination through limit and offset parameters.

- Scopes: idn:access-model-metadata:manage, idn:access-model-metadata:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: key: eq, co; name: eq, co; type: eq; status: eq; objectTypes: eq — e.g. `name eq "Privacy"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: key, name, type, status — e.g. `name,-key`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of attributedto

### POST /access-model-metadata/v1/attributes

`createAccessModelMetadataAttributeV1` — Create access model metadata attribute

Create a new Access Model Metadata Attribute. The **isAdhoc** field can be set on creation to indicate whether the Attribute supports ad-hoc (dynamically created) values in addition to static values; if omitted, it defaults to *false*. Any **values** provided at creation time must each have a *type* of *static* (or omit/leave *type* blank); *adhoc* is not an allowed value on this public API and results in a *400* error. Ad-hoc values are created dynamically through an internal…

- Scopes: idn:access-model-metadata:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): attributedto
- Returns 201: attributedto

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN

### POST /access-model-metadata/v1/attributes/{key}/values

`createAccessModelMetadataAttributeValueV1` — Create access model metadata value

Create a new value for an existing Access Model Metadata Attribute. The **type** field must be omitted, blank, or *static* (case-insensitive); *adhoc* is not an allowed value on this public API and results in a *400* error. Ad-hoc values are created dynamically through an internal service-to-service flow when the parent Attribute has *isAdhoc* set to *true*, not through this API.

- Scopes: idn:access-model-metadata:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `key` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute.
- Body (application/json): attributevaluedto
- Returns 201: attributevaluedto
